name: d1-rate-limit
title: Fixed-window rate limits in D1 that fail closed in production
description: One atomic UPSERT ... RETURNING per call counts hits per name and key (IP, API key, member) in a D1 table shared by every isolate. In production a missing table or unreachable D1 counts as limited. A Hono middleware answers 429 with Retry-After, and purgeExpired cleans old windows from a cron.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: appSlug
params.description: Short name used for resources (D1 name in the config patch).

params.name: tablePrefix
params.description: Prefix for the block's table; set when the project already has a rate_limits table.

env.name: ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Set to "production" in the deployed Worker; it switches the limiter to fail closed.

agent.summary: Adds D1-backed fixed-window rate limits to a Hono Worker: one table, a rateLimit middleware and an isRateLimited function. In production it fails closed when D1 or the table is unavailable. Costs one D1 write per call.
when_to_use: Login, code-sending or other abuse-prone routes need a limit shared across isolates.
You already use D1 and want no extra binding.
when_not_to_use: Traffic above roughly 50 requests per second per Worker: use the Workers Rate Limiting binding.
You need a sliding window or per-request spend caps.

adapt.title: Set ENVIRONMENT=production in the deployed Worker
adapt.do: Add "ENVIRONMENT": "production" to the production environment's vars so the limiter fails closed.
adapt.check: With the table dropped in a staging deploy, limited routes answer 429, not 200.

adapt.title: Put rateLimit in front of the routes to protect
adapt.do: import { rateLimit } from './lib/rate-limit'; app.use('/auth/*', rateLimit({ name: 'auth', limit: 10, window: '15 m' }));
adapt.check: The 11th request in 15 minutes from one IP gets 429 with Retry-After.

adapt.title: Purge expired windows daily
adapt.do: Add triggers.crons to wrangler.jsonc and call purgeExpired(env.DB) from the scheduled handler.
adapt.check: SELECT count(*) on the table stays small.

agent.author_notes: Behind a proxy that is not Cloudflare, getClientIp returns "unknown" and every caller shares one counter; pass your own key function.
